keyFacts: World's largest supplier of athletic shoes and apparel
Founded 1964 as Blue Ribbon Sports by Bill Bowerman and Phil Knight; became Nike, Inc. in 1971
Slogan 'Just Do It' (1988) and the Swoosh logo are among the most recognized trademarks in sports
Women's signature basketball business grew nearly 500% from 2022 to 2026
Caitlin 1 launch (Oct 2026) was the biggest women's signature shoe launch in Nike history, ~5,000 retail doors
marketingChannels: Signature athlete partnerships (e.g. Caitlin Clark, LeBron James)
Run clubs and grassroots running culture
tagline: Bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete in the world
